name: Страшные клоуны
alt: Два клоуна-скелета с нелепыми причёсками и пищащим резиновым цыплёнком.
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset: one square original illustration for a humorous fantasy card game, readable at 384x384. Funny expressive caricature, bold clean ink contours, loose watercolor and gouache on warm lightly mottled parchment, saturated colors, chunky simple forms and strong silhouette. Large centered subject, comfortable margins, minimal scenery, one visual joke. No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, border or card frame. Original composition, do not copy existing card art. Clear anatomy, no duplicated limbs. Subject: Exactly TWO goofy undead skeleton clowns in ragged colorful circus suits, one tall and skinny in turquoise stripes, one squat in purple polka dots. White bony faces, red ball noses, silly orange and blue wigs. Tall clown holds a limp yellow rubber chicken, short clown offers a drooping balloon shaped like a skull. Each has exactly two arms and two legs. Funny spooky, no blood or gore, no realistic horror, no resemblance to movie clowns.
